extraction.notes: IRT reports FFO and CFFO (its adjusted FFO metric) with no AFFO subtotal, so affo fields are null. The FFO line 'Loss on impairment (gain on sale) of real estate assets, net, excluding prepayment gains' is a combined impairment/gain line (amount 73); categorized as property_sale_gain_loss. Prepayment (gains) penalties on asset dispositions (-1,569) categorized as debt_extinguishment; 'Other loss' (103) categorized as other. Diluted shares use weighted average common shares and OP units 236,665,226 (shown in thousands as 236,665.226); reproduces FFO/share $0.28 and CFFO/share $0.27. Recurring capex of $5.5 million for the quarter is taken from the Capital Expenditures narrative on page 4 (total portfolio scope), since CFFO does not subtract recurring capex. All figures in the three-month March 31, 2025 column; subtotals verified (FFO 67,364; CFFO 64,238).
